title: ANALYTICA
summary: A data science challenge where teams make every decision from the data, under time pressure.
description: Teams step into a simulated real-world business scenario and let data-driven insight guide every move. ANALYTICA tests analytical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving under pressure, bridging the gap between theory and practice.

title: The Resume Hack
summary: How to build a resume that gets through ATS screening and stands out to recruiters.
description: Part of the Placement Unfiltered series, organised with the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. A practical session on presenting your profile well, since the resume is the first filter in a competitive placement season.

title: REWIRED
venue: Phase one online on Google Meet, phase two at Idea Factory KS02
summary: A two-level IoT skill training program with hybrid, hands-on sessions.
description: Presented by the chapter's Internet of Things domain. Phase one ran online on 3 March, followed by a hands-on phase two at the Idea Factory (KS02) on 6 March. Seats were limited.

title: Champion's Mic: The Winner's Playbook
summary: SIH 2024 champions from the software and hardware tracks on how to pitch, prototype and win.
description: A Smart India Hackathon 2025 pre-event featuring SIH 2024 champions from both the software and hardware tracks, sharing how they pitched, prototyped and won.

title: LLM Tuned
summary: Working with large language models properly, because copy-pasting from Google won't cut it.
description: A two-evening online workshop on large language models and how to tune and use them well.

title: Datavizzx
summary: Data visualisation and analytics fundamentals with Microsoft Power BI.
description: The Datavizzx workshop introduced participants to the fundamentals of data visualisation and analytics using Microsoft Power BI.

title: Operation Shadow
summary: Hands-on cybersecurity: network security, ethical hacking and threat prevention.
description: The Operation Shadow cybersecurity workshop provided hands-on training in network security, ethical hacking and threat prevention.

title: Cloudscape
summary: AWS cloud architecture, IAM, serverless deployment and cost optimisation.
description: The Cloudscape AWS workshop offered hands-on training in cloud architecture, core services, IAM, serverless deployment and cost optimisation.
